art.subject: South Polar Skua (Stercorarius maccormicki), adult of a pale to intermediate morph, as seen over the open sea off Korea in summer: head, neck and underparts plain cold pale greyish-brown to greyish-buff, clearly paler than the mantle and wings, with fine pale straw-coloured streaks on the hindneck; mantle and wings dark blackish-brown, unmarked, contrasting with the paler body; underwing coverts blackish; a conspicuous white flash at the base of the primaries on both the upper and lower wing; no rufous tones anywhere. Bill black, stout and hooked; dark eye; legs and webbed feet black.
art.pose: flying low and steadily over the swell on broad wings, white primary flashes showing
art.scene: open sea far off the Korean East Sea coast in summer, long blue-grey swell under a hazy sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult pale to intermediate morph, in flight seen squarely from below: barrel-chested, head, body and tail in one line, broad wings spread out to the sides to their full span bent slightly at the wrist, blackish underwing coverts, white flash at the base of the primaries, whitish to straw-brown head and body, short tail, feet tucked under the body

adult pale to intermediate morph, in flight seen squarely from above: broad wings spread out to the sides to their full span, dark grey-brown back and upperwings with a white flash at the base of the primaries, paler head and neck with pale streaks on the nape and hindneck, short dark tail
art.build: Large, heavy-bodied skua, about as long as a Black-tailed Gull but much bulkier and broader-chested, looking like a dark, powerful gull. Bill stout and deep, black, with a strongly hooked tip. Wings broad-based and rather blunt; tail short and slightly wedge-shaped, the central feathers projecting only a little. Flight steady with shallow wingbeats, turning to fast, agile chases of other seabirds. Legs short and black.
avoid: Do not paint long pointed or twisted central tail streamers (jaegers); the tail is short with only a slight central projection.
Do not paint a black cap, a breast band or barred flanks (Pomarine Jaeger).
Do not paint warm rufous or cinnamon streaking on the body (Great Skua of the Atlantic).
Do not omit the white flash at the base of the primaries.
Do not paint a gull-like white body or a yellow bill.
